subject: Dropsiders V2 : Nouvelle plateforme média & agenda interactif ! 🎙️
body:
Hi,

My name is Caroline, and I’m reaching out on behalf of the Dropsiders team and Alex.

We’re really looking forward to EDC Thailand! I just wanted to follow up and check whether you have received our media accreditation request to cover the festival.

We would be happy to discuss this further and provide any additional information or documents needed for the accreditation process.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Best regards,
Caroline
Dropside Team
